question: 202604，MDL工厂各个产品大类实际投入数量
sql: SELECT product_attributes.common_categories, SUM(production_actuals.Panel_qty) AS actual_input_panel_qty FROM production_actuals INNER JOIN product_attributes ON production_actuals.product_ID = product_attributes.product_ID WHERE production_actuals.work_date BETWEEN '20260401' AND '20260430' AND production_actuals.FACTORY = 'MDL' AND production_actuals.act_type = '投入' GROUP BY product_attributes.common_categories FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: 验证产品大类/产品类别/产品分类收敛到 common_categories；MDL 工厂实际投入数量默认走 Panel_qty 口径。

question: 26年MDL工厂top10投入型号及其物量
sql: SELECT product_ID, SUM(Panel_qty) AS actual_input_panel_qty FROM production_actuals WHERE work_date BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20261231' AND FACTORY = 'MDL' AND act_type = '投入' GROUP BY product_ID ORDER BY actual_input_panel_qty DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;
notes: 基于 production_actuals，过滤 act_type=投入；MDL 物量默认使用 Panel_qty，并按投入物量降序取 top10 型号。

question: 2026年2月Array工厂审批版投入物量与实际物量Gap和达成率
sql: WITH approved_input AS (SELECT plan_month AS biz_month, factory_code AS factory, SUM(target_IN_glass_qty) AS approved_input_qty FROM monthly_plan_approved WHERE plan_month = '202602' AND factory_code = 'ARRAY' GROUP BY plan_month, factory_code), actual_input AS (SELECT SUBSTR(work_date, 1, 6) AS biz_month, FACTORY AS factory, SUM(GLS_qty) AS actual_input_qty FROM production_actuals WHERE SUBSTR(work_date, 1, 6) = '202602' AND FACTORY = 'ARRAY' AND act_type = '投入' GROUP BY SUBSTR(work_date, 1, 6), FACTORY) SELECT approved_input.biz_month AS biz_month, approved_input.factory AS factory, approved_input.approved_input_qty, NVL(actual_input.actual_input_qty, 0) AS actual_input_qty, NVL(actual_input.actual_input_qty, 0) - approved_input.approved_input_qty AS input_gap_qty, CASE WHEN approved_input.approved_input_qty = 0 THEN NULL ELSE NVL(actual_input.actual_input_qty, 0) / approved_input.approved_input_qty END AS input_achievement_rate FROM approved_input LEFT JOIN actual_input ON approved_input.biz_month = actual_input.biz_month AND approved_input.factory = actual_input.factory ORDER BY approved_input.biz_month FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: 审批侧和实际侧必须先分别按月份、工厂聚合，再 join 聚合结果。Array 口径默认使用 GLS_qty 与 target_IN_glass_qty。Gap = 实际投入 - 审批投入；达成率 = 实际投入 / 审批投入。

question: 最新5版p版需求中，202604需求量最多的fgcode是哪一个
sql: WITH latest_versions AS (SELECT PM_VERSION FROM (SELECT PM_VERSION FROM p_demand GROUP BY PM_VERSION ORDER BY PM_VERSION DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5), demand_unpivot AS (SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) AS demand_month, REQUIREMENT_QTY AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 1), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, NEXT_REQUIREMENT AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 2), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, LAST_REQUIREMENT AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 3), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH4 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 4), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH5 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 5), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH6 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 6), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH7 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand) SELECT FGCODE, SUM(demand_qty) AS demand_qty FROM demand_unpivot WHERE demand_month = '202604' AND PM_VERSION IN (SELECT PM_VERSION FROM latest_versions) GROUP BY FGCODE ORDER BY demand_qty DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY;
notes: P 版需求是横表，必须展开目标 demand_month；最新 5 版先取 PM_VERSION 最新 5 个值，再按 202604 汇总并取需求量最高的 FGCODE。

question: 最新p版，最近6个月的ttl需求物量
sql: WITH latest_version AS (SELECT MAX(PM_VERSION) AS PM_VERSION FROM p_demand), demand_unpivot AS (SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, CUSTOMER, CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) AS demand_month, REQUIREMENT_QTY AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, CUSTOMER, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 1), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, NEXT_REQUIREMENT AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, CUSTOMER, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 2), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, LAST_REQUIREMENT AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, CUSTOMER, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 3), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH4 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, CUSTOMER, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 4), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH5 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, CUSTOMER, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 5), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH6 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, CUSTOMER, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 6), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH7 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand) SELECT demand_month, SUM(NVL(demand_qty, 0)) AS ttl_demand_qty FROM demand_unpivot WHERE PM_VERSION IN (SELECT PM_VERSION FROM latest_version) AND demand_month BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -5), 'YYYYMM') AND TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 'YYYYMM') GROUP BY demand_month ORDER BY demand_month FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: 最新 P 版取 MAX(PM_VERSION)；横表需求月份展开后，按最近 6 个 demand_month 汇总 total 需求物量。

question: 最新P版，2026年5月，Oxide产品数量是多少
sql: WITH latest_version AS (SELECT MAX(PM_VERSION) AS PM_VERSION FROM p_demand), demand_unpivot AS (SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) AS demand_month, REQUIREMENT_QTY AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 1), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, NEXT_REQUIREMENT AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 2), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, LAST_REQUIREMENT AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 3), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH4 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 4), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH5 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 5), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH6 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand UNION ALL SELECT PM_VERSION, FGCODE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CAST(MONTH AS VARCHAR2(6)) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 6), 'YYYYMM') AS demand_month, MONTH7 AS demand_qty FROM p_demand) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_attributes.product_ID) AS product_count, SUM(NVL(demand_unpivot.demand_qty, 0)) AS total_demand_qty FROM demand_unpivot JOIN product_attributes ON demand_unpivot.FGCODE = product_attributes.product_ID WHERE demand_unpivot.PM_VERSION IN (SELECT PM_VERSION FROM latest_version) AND demand_unpivot.demand_month = '202605' AND NVL(demand_unpivot.demand_qty, 0) > 0 AND product_attributes.IS_OXIDE = 'Y' FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: 同时要求最新版本过滤、横表需求月份展开、产品属性过滤。目标月份必须过滤展开后的 demand_month，不要直接过滤 p_demand.MONTH。Oxide 落在 product_attributes.IS_OXIDE = 'Y'；产品数量使用 COUNT(DISTINCT product_attributes.product_ID)，需求总数使用 SUM(NVL(demand_qty, 0))，且只统计 NVL(demand_qty, 0) > 0 的产品。

question: oms库存，近6个月库存变化趋势
sql: SELECT oms_inventory.report_month AS biz_month, SUM(oms_inventory.glass_qty) AS inventory_glass_qty, SUM(oms_inventory.panel_qty) AS inventory_panel_qty FROM oms_inventory WHERE oms_inventory.report_month BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -5), 'YYYYMM') AND TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 'YYYYMM') GROUP BY oms_inventory.report_month ORDER BY oms_inventory.report_month FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: OMS 库存趋势必须走 oms_inventory，按 report_month 展示；非库龄场景默认同时返回 glass_qty 与 panel_qty 两套库存口径。

question: 最新OMS库存，TtL物量，对应库龄分布情况，库龄分为<3M、3-6M、6-12M、>12M
sql: SELECT SUM(ONE_AGE_panel_qty + TWO_AGE_panel_qty + THREE_AGE_panel_qty) AS lt_3m_qty, SUM(FOUR_AGE_panel_qty) AS m3_6m_qty, SUM(FIVE_AGE_panel_qty) AS m6_12m_qty, SUM(SIX_AGE_panel_qty + SEVEN_AGE_panel_qty + EUGHT_AGE_panel_qty) AS gt_12m_qty FROM oms_inventory WHERE report_month = (SELECT MAX(report_month) FROM oms_inventory) FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: 最新 OMS 库存默认取 MAX(report_month)。库龄桶映射：<3M = ONE+TWO+THREE，3-6M = FOUR，6-12M = FIVE，>12M = SIX+SEVEN+EUGHT。不要额外按产品分类、客户、型号拆分。
